name: April Baskin

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to PFC Travis C. Krege
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting the bridge on Cleveland Drive crossing interstate route 90 in the town of Cheektowaga, county of Erie, to PFC Travis C. Krege.

sponsored.t: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before a certain date
sponsored.sum: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before June 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system
sponsored.sum: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. The Commissioner of Transportation shall provide for the installation and maintenance of adequate signage to state "Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad Byway".

sponsored.t: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for certain programs
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for division of minority and women's business development programs by changing the basis from number of employees to annual receipts.

sponsored.t: Requires state contracts with construction firms reserve a percent of such contract to soft cost spending towards small businesses
sponsored.sum: Requires state contracts with construction firms reserve a percent of such contract to soft cost spending towards small businesses located near the construction site; defines what qualifies as soft cost spending.
sponsored.fis: Costs can likely be absorbed into other regulatory processes for utili- zation and workforce usage.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers.

sponsored.t: Requires the director of the division of minority and women's business development in the department of economic development to give additional time for a business enterprise to cure defects
sponsored.sum: Requires the director of the division of minority and women's business development in the department of economic development to give additional time for a business enterprise to cure defects in its application for certification or correct defects when a certification is denied, revoked, or changed.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.
sponsored.fis: Pursuant to Legislative Law, Section 50: This bill would authorize Janice Middlebrooks to file an ordinary disability application with a date of retirement of November 1, 2004 and an option election form with a joint allowance full option on behalf of her deceased husband William James Middlebrooks. Mr. Middlebrooks received a disability retirement which was paid beginning on 3/28/2005. Upon his death all payments ceased because no option election falai was filed. By filing the disa- bility application and an option election form, an additional benefit will be paid for the period 11/1/04 - 3/28/05 and a benefit will contin- ue to Janice Middlebrooks for her lifetime. If this bill is enacted, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $472,000 which will be shared by the State of New York and all of the participating employers in the New York State and Local Employees'…

sponsored.t: Enacts "India's law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "India's law" under which an incarcerated individual's next of kin shall be notified and allowed visitation by a local correctional facility when such individual is experiencing a serious medical event or demonstrating behavior that is likely to result in serious harm to themselves or others.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation for the purposes of constructing a mixed-use campus for the community benefit.

sponsored.t: Establishes the block by block homeownership program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the block by block homeownership program to provide capital subsidies for the purpose of constructing, preserving, and rehabilitating one- to two- family dwellings throughout the state, outside of NYC.

sponsored.t: Relates to the staffing and operations of a cancer research institute and a related not-for-profit corporation
sponsored.sum: Transfers the Buffalo Division of Health Research, Inc. to the Roswell Park Cancer Research Corporation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the provision of law that volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers who receive a real property tax exemption for service may not receive the income tax credit for such service.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the New York state power authority to rename the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant to the Shirley J. Hamilton Niagara Power Plant
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the New York state power authority to rename the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant located in the town of Lewiston, county of Niagara, to the Shirley J. Hamilton Niagara Power Plant.

sponsored.t: Relates to the residence of the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna to reside anywhere in Erie county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Bonnie E. Sullivan, the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan, to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed.
sponsored.fis: There will be an immediate past service cost of $245,000 borne by the city of Buffalo as a one time payment.

sponsored.t: Provides for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions providing for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie.
sponsored.fis: Produces lower interest rates for the county of Erie in negotiating the sale of their bonds.

sponsored.t: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo
sponsored.sum: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo.

sponsored.t: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2027
sponsored.sum: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act"
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act" (FRESH Communities); provides loans, loan guarantees, interest subsidies and grants to businesses, municipalities, not-for-profit corporations or local development corporations for the purpose of attracting, maintaining or permitting the expansion of food retail establishments in underserved areas.

sponsored.t: Establishes a public online registry of vacant commercial storefronts
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public online registry of vacant commercial storefronts; provides information to current and prospective small business owners seeking to purchase or lease a vacant storefront for a small business location.

sponsored.t: Requires the division for small-business to publish a small business compliance guide
sponsored.sum: Requires the division for small-business to publish a small business compliance guide and post such guide to the division for small-business's website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the white elephant housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program for qualified rehabilitation expenditures totaling fifty million dollars or more with respect to a certified historic structure that has been vacant, as determined by local code enforcement or other reasonable means, for at least ten of fifteen consecutive years preceding the date of the taxpayer's application for the rehabilitation credit.

sponsored.t: Expands the use of body scanners to facilities operated by the office of mental health, the office for people with developmental disabilities and the office of children and family services
sponsored.sum: Expands the use of body scanners to facilities operated by the office of mental health and the office for people with developmental disabilities; establishes alternative methods of screening.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Buffalo to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Buffalo to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands for the construction, operation, maintenance, and repair of a utility thermal energy network project.

sponsored.t: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments
sponsored.sum: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments; provides that participants may respond to an emergency or hazardous activity, but shall remain in an appropriate and safe designated area that has been established by the chief or officer in charge; provides such participants cannot respond to an emergency on a vehicle using lights and/or sirens; provides such participants may not enter a burning structure; protects volunteer fire departments and fire companies from certain criminal and civil liability potentially arising from the operation of a youth program.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Schultz
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Ronald Schultz.

sponsored.t: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program to represent small businesses on issues relating to state energy policy and the goals of the climate leadership and community protection act.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing local municipalities to establish tourism improvement districts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local municipalities to establish or expand tourism improvement districts and provide services thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"; provides the city of Buffalo specific procedures for the appointment of a receiver of rents in instances where the property at issue is neglected or abandoned.

sponsored.t: Adds employee-owned enterprises to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state
sponsored.sum: Adds employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state; authorizes such enterprises and cooperatives to make certain purchases from centralized contracts for commodities, subject to conditions of the office of general services; authorizes the comptroller to conduct certain audits of employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities on the campus of D'Youville University.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to develop a public awareness campaign promoting businesses located in New York state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to develop a public awareness campaign promoting businesses located in New York state with an emphasis on small businesses and the need to shop in downtown local areas; requires the creation of the Buy New York Online Networking Directory to connect purchasers with businesses located in New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "honesty in cut meat act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "honesty in cut meat act" under which grocery stores must display signage that distinguishes between store-cut meat and pre-cut, pre-packaged meat.

sponsored.t: Expands the type of certifications that may be accepted by the state of New York for restricted licenses
sponsored.sum: Expands the type of certifications that may be accepted by the state of New York for restricted licenses; requires individuals may only perform toxicology testing in a laboratory authorized by the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires that an organization applying for grant funding shall provide to arts agencies a certification that it will enter into a labor peace agreement with at least one bona fide labor organization
sponsored.sum: Requires that an organization applying for grant funding shall provide to arts agencies a certification that it will enter into a labor peace agreement with at least one bona fide labor organization either where such bona fide labor organization is actively representing employees providing services covered by the organization seeking such grant funding or upon notice by a bona fide labor organization that is attempting to represent employees who will provide services to the organization seeking such grant funding; relates to prevailing wage requirements for not-for-profit theaters and payment of their employees on productions funded by the New York state council on the arts or arts agencies…

sponsored.t: Relates to assisting persons with medically diagnosed HIV infection; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to assisting persons with medically diagnosed HIV infection.

sponsored.t: Relates to automatic eligibility for early intervention services for children found to have elevated venous blood lead levels
sponsored.sum: Relates to automatic eligibility for early intervention services for children found to have elevated venous blood lead levels (at or above 5 mcg/dl).

sponsored.t: Relates to providing secondary bonding authority to the Buffalo fiscal stability authority
sponsored.sum: Provides secondary bonding authority up to $46,000,000 to the Buffalo fiscal stability authority during the period of July 1, 2026 and June 30, 2030; extends the authority to 2047.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "language access expansion act"
sponsored.sum: Requires certain documents and forms to be provided in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited English proficient immigrants of five years or less according to the American community survey, as published by the United States census bureau.

sponsored.t: Authorizes cities and towns, except New York city, to establish community housing funds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes cities and towns, except a city with a population of one million or more, to establish community housing funds; authorizes such cities and towns to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited in such funds; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. This bill will generate revenue for municipalities to provide community housing opportunities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state innovation voucher program
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state innovation voucher program; provides small businesses with access to research and development by colleges and universities, government laboratories and public research institutes in order to assist such businesses in the creation of innovative products or services.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for certain sites
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located within the Renaissance Commerce Park situate within the city of Lackawanna, Erie county.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination in government procurement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination in government procurement.

sponsored.t: Relates to delinquent tax interest rates
sponsored.sum: Relates to setting a minimum and maximum delinquent tax interest rate for payments due on residential real property.

sponsored.t: Renames the block grant for child care to the early childhood fund and requires the office of children and family services administer such fund
sponsored.sum: Renames the block grant for child care to the early childhood fund; requires the office of children and family services administer such fund; expands who qualifies for guaranteed child care assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to motor vehicle insurance fairness; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to motor vehicle insurance fairness; provides that insurance rates shall not be increased based on certain factors; sets forth processes for motor vehicle insurers to have rate increases approved; allows public access in relation to any proposed insurance rate increases; allows members of the public to request permission to intervene in proceedings related to rate increases; directs rules and regulations to be established.

sponsored.t: Relates to small business savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Relates to small business savings accounts; provides tax incentives for contributions and distributions.
sponsored.fis: Approximately $20 million (dependent on how many eligibly small busi- nesses opt in).

sponsored.t: Authorizes recoupment of financial incentives awarded businesses upon failure to fulfill the terms of such incentive
sponsored.sum: Authorizes recoupment by the state or any political subdivision of financial incentives such as awards, loans, grants or tax abatements, awarded businesses for purposes of job training, job creation or retention, or the development of business operations, upon recipient's failure to complete the terms of the incentive.
sponsored.fis: An increase in tax revenues from employed workers and expanded oper- ations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the hire a vet grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the hire a vet grant program; provides grants to municipalities where a veteran is hired and employed, for not less than twelve continuous and uninterrupted months in a full-time or part-time position.

sponsored.t: Adds Down syndrome to the definition of developmental disability and expands such definition to include certain individuals below the age of ten
sponsored.sum: Adds Down syndrome to the definition of developmental disability for the purpose of making Down syndrome an automatic qualifier for Medicaid; expands the definition of developmental disability to include certain individuals below the age of ten who cannot demonstrate that their disability constitutes a substantial handicap to their ability to function in a normal society, but that have a high probability of meeting such criteria later in life; expands the definition of developmental disability to include certain individuals below the age of four.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veterans' services organization capital support program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the veterans' services organization capital support program to provide funding for payment of the capital costs of construction, improvement, repairs, rehabilitation, or reconstruction of certain facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises, service-disabled veteran-owned businesses, small businesses and microbusinesses by businesses operating in state-funded buildings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises, service-disabled veteran-owned businesses, small businesses and microbusinesses in state-funded construction projects; directs the empire state development corporation, in consultation with other state agencies, to develop a state division of post-construction commitments and compliance to create rules and regulations for private businesses operating in buildings constructed using state funding to have certain employment goals and living wage requirements, annual minority and women-owned business enterprise, certified service-disabled veteran-owned business, small business and microbusiness utilization goals for…

sponsored.t: Provides that microbusinesses in New York are eligible for small business revolving loans and the linked deposit interest rate reductions
sponsored.sum: Provides that microbusinesses in New York are eligible for small business revolving loans and the linked deposit interest rate reductions.
sponsored.fis: No additional cost to the state is estimated.

sponsored.t: Relates to the entering of lands owned or occupied by any nation, tribe, or band of Indians by a person and to law enforcement agreements with the Seneca nation
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person shall not be deemed to have entered the lands owned or occupied by a nation, tribe, or band of Indians if such person is temporarily and continuously passing through such lands; provides that at the request of the Seneca nation, the superintendent of state police, a sheriff of a county that includes lands of the Seneca nation, or the chief of police of the city of Salamanca may enter into an agreement with the Seneca nation detailing the activities such law enforcement entity will undertake within the nation's federally-recognized Indian Country lands; provides that such agreements shall not be construed to limit powers, duties, and responsibilities to undertake…

sponsored.t: Permits local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records
sponsored.sum: Permits local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records relating to a death.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain business enterprise subcontractors who seek to do work with not-for-profit corporations from certain requirements
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain business enterprise subcontractors who seek to do work with not-for-profit corporations to receive MWBE certification if certain criteria is met; imposes a $50,001 limit on the provision of such services or work; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Creates a small business electric energy tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates a small business electric energy tax credit; specifies that the amount of credit shall be equal to the product of $0.02 per kilowatt hour; sets limit of no more than 19 full-time employees in New York state; determines that if the business is located at the primary residence of a sole proprietor, the business is not eligible for the tax credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax credit for employers who contribute to a college choice tuition savings account on behalf of an employee
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for employers who contribute to a college choice tuition savings account on behalf of an employee.
sponsored.fis: Assuming that approximately 25-30 percent of employers claim the credit, net tax receipts will decrease by approximately $15 million annually (the average amount between 25% and 30% participation rate). The loss of revenue to the State in the State Fiscal Year 2020 is $3 million. Once it is fully annualized, the loss of revenue to the State is approx- imately $15 million per year.

sponsored.t: Includes part of Ridge Road in the city of Lackawanna as a state highway
sponsored.sum: Includes part of Ridge Road in the city of Lackawanna as a state highway.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act" to provide for grants to certain hospitals, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Nurse of Tomorrow Act" to provide for grants from the state commissioner of education to public and not-for-profit hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, schools and other entities for nurse recruitment, education and retention costs and activities as described herein.

sponsored.t: Relates to aid payable to low spending high need school districts
sponsored.sum: Provides for supplemental aid payable to low spending high need school districts in the 2026-2027 school year and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Decreases the time a vacant property may sit in foreclosure in Erie County
sponsored.sum: Decreases the time a vacant property may sit in foreclosure in Erie county.

sponsored.t: Designates South Park Avenue in or near Lackawanna a state highway
sponsored.sum: Designates South Park Avenue in or near Lackawanna as a state highway.

sponsored.t: Authorizes tuition assistance program awards for students enrolled in short-term credential programs offered by certain public institutions
sponsored.sum: Authorizes tuition assistance program awards for students enrolled in short-term credential programs offered by certain public institutions.

sponsored.t: Provides for E-ZPass availability and waiving deposit fees for a certain period after a rate increase
sponsored.sum: Relates to E-ZPass availability and waiving deposit fees for a certain period after a rate increase.

sponsored.t: Adds assaults against certain employees of state and local government agencies as an assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes a person is guilty of assault in the second degree when such person intends to cause physical injury to an employee of New York state or any of its political subdivisions or of a public authority or a public benefit corporation while such employee is performing such employee's duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criteria for financing certain lead service line and pipe replacements
sponsored.sum: Relates to the criteria for financing certain lead service line and pipe replacements by the environmental facilities corporation.
sponsored.fis: The costs of this bill would need lead service line replacement across our State to be increased to $500,000,000. It is estimated that there are 500,000 service lines in New York that contain lead and will cost $5 billion to replace every single line

sponsored.t: Establishes the contract New York program; establishes the contract New York tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the contract New York program to provide tax credits to corporations contracting with emerging microbusinesses; directs the department of economic development and the empire state development corporation to create and maintain a registry of emerging microbusinesses and to biannually implement best practices for engaging corporations to utilize such registry; establishes the contract New York tax credit for New York corporations with eligible contracts with emerging microbusinesses.
sponsored.fis: Need SFC assistance to estimate tax implications

sponsored.t: Relates to granting peace officer status to park rangers of Erie county
sponsored.sum: Grants certain park rangers and building security of Erie county peace officer status to issue appearance tickets, simplified traffic informations, simplified parks informations and simplified environmental conservation informations; provides that such shall not be deemed to authorize such officer to carry, possess, repair or dispose of a firearm unless the appropriate license has been issued therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires street pricing for pre-packaged food and beverage items sold by vendors at certain transportation facilities and on toll roads
sponsored.sum: Requires street pricing for pre-packaged food and beverage items sold by vendors at certain transportation facilities and on toll roads; defines street pricing; provides that vendors may be subject to civil penalties not to exceed five hundred dollars per violation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fair concession pricing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fair concession pricing act" to require certain entertainment and sports venues constructed or operating under public financial benefit to implement fan-friendly concession pricing policies.

sponsored.t: Extends the statute of limitations for coroners, coroners' physicians and medical examiners for article 78 proceedings
sponsored.sum: Extends the statute of limitations for coroners, coroners' physicians and medical examiners for article 78 proceedings to ten years.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting on merit determinations relating to unfair labor practices and a certificate of compliance to be eligible for state economic incentives
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting on merit determinations relating to unfair labor practices to the department of labor and a certificate of compliance to be eligible for state economic incentives.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Cheektowaga
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Cheektowaga, county of Erie.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purpose of such corporation and the use of certain tax monies received by the Rescue Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association Inc. in the town of Cheektowaga, Erie county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purpose of such corporation and the use of certain tax monies received by the Rescue Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association Inc. in the town of Cheektowaga, Erie county.

sponsored.t: Permits the commissioner of health to designate local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records
sponsored.sum: Permits the commissioner of health to designate local health officials to request copies of certain reports and records relating to a death.

sponsored.t: Requires schools safety plans to include a cardiac emergency response plan
sponsored.sum: Requires schools safety plans to include a cardiac emergency response plan that addresses the use of appropriate personnel and measures to respond to incidents involving any individual experiencing sudden cardiac arrest or similar life-threatening emergency on any school site owned or operated by a school or at a location of a school sponsored event.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of "protected consumer"
sponsored.sum: Defines a "protected consumer" as an individual who is under the age of eighteen years.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provision of law relating to value limitations for certain emergency contracts for public works or the purchase of supplies
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions of law relating to value limitations for certain emergency contracts for public works or the purchase of supplies.

sponsored.t: Relates to hair relaxer labeling
sponsored.sum: Requires that hair relaxer products display labels when they contain certain dangerous chemicals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the management of oysters
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage oysters from December 31, 2025 to December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiting list for organs
sponsored.sum: Removes the prohibition on patient participation in multiple transplant programs in New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to procurement requirements for end point device security
sponsored.sum: Directs that state agencies require that procurement of end point devices be consistent with any relevant standards, guidelines, or guidance developed as part of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework.
